ngaap.guidance: Q1-18: GAAP diluted EPS $0.71-$0.74; adjusted diluted EPS $0.90-$0.93 (pretax amortization $0.24 / $170.1m pretax, $134.4m after-tax; tax effect ($0.05)). FY2018: GAAP diluted EPS $3.50-$3.60; adjusted diluted EPS maintained at $4.25-$4.35 (pretax amortization $0.95 / $679.9m pretax, $537.1m after-tax; tax effect ($0.20)). No core growth guidance in the release.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP) adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (tax-effected in the aggregate 'Tax effect' line) plus gains/charges deemed non-recurring (sale of investments, restructuring plans fundamentally different from ongoing DBS productivity, acquisition-related items, early extinguishment of debt) and discrete tax items. From 2017 (ASU 2016-09) equity-compensation excess tax benefits above ~$10m/quarter anticipated are excluded. No adjusted operating profit or margin is published. Item after-tax amounts are from the release footnotes. Q4-17 US tax reform: the 'Discrete tax adjustments and other tax-related adjustments' line ((0.13) / $95m) nets a $1,219m gain from remeasuring deferred tax assets/liabilities under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, a $1,218m transition-tax provision on deemed repatriation, and $94m of discrete gains (statute-of-limitation expirations); TCJA items roughly offset (net +$1m). FY2017 adjusted EPS 4.03 (GAAP 3.50; amortization 0.94; acquisition-matter gains (0.02); investment gain (0.10); Q2 restructuring 0.11; tax effect (0.19); discrete (0.21) = $146m incl. $16m ASU 2016-09). No free cash flow table in the release (text cites 'mid-teens growth in free cash flow'; FY2017 operating cash flow $3.5bn).
